hunks.baseline: From the moment the last breath of the evil Dragon that had terrorized the whole world for thousands of years dispersed, an unstoppable catastrophe had been racing along its predetermined course.
hunks.sol: From the moment the last breath of the evil Dragon that had terrorized the world for thousands of years faded, an unstoppable catastrophe had been racing along its predetermined course.

hunks.baseline: As if this were all it had left to do, the Dragon Heart had, for the first time, slipped beyond its master’s control and vomited everything it had accumulated over an unfathomably long time out into the world.
hunks.sol: As if this were all it had left to do, the Dragon Heart slipped beyond its master’s control for the first time and vomited everything it had accumulated over untold ages into the world.

hunks.baseline: Using the body of the Dragon that had finally met its end as kindling, it raged more fiercely than a newly awakened active volcano.
hunks.sol: With the dead Dragon’s body for fuel, it raged more fiercely than an active volcano newly awakened.

hunks.baseline: Before the deafening roar that shook heaven and earth even reached their ears, everyone on the battlefield felt the terrifying shock wave.
hunks.sol: Before the deafening roar that shook heaven and earth even reached their ears, everyone on the battlefield felt its terrifying shock wave.

hunks.baseline: The S-rank Hunters were gathering the bodies of the seven Guardians who had found peace with Morgoth’s death—their former comrades.
hunks.sol: The S-rank Hunters gathering the bodies of the seven Guardians who had found peace with Morgoth’s death—no, their former comrades.

hunks.baseline: Thousands of Hunters were chasing monsters that had lost the will to fight and scattered in every direction.
hunks.sol: The thousands of Hunters pursuing monsters that had lost the will to fight and scattered in every direction.

hunks.baseline: The solitary groan that slipped from someone’s lips spoke for everyone staring at the scene before them in stunned disbelief.
hunks.sol: The groan that slipped from someone’s lips spoke for everyone staring at the scene in stunned disbelief.

hunks.baseline: The evil Dragon—Morgoth—was definitely dead.
hunks.sol: The evil Dragon—Morgoth—was dead. Of that there was no doubt.

hunks.baseline: Their senses and minds, frozen by the icy magical power, simply hadn’t reacted in time to the memory of *that day*—the day that had arrived without a word of warning just a few decades ago.
hunks.sol: Their senses and minds, frozen by the icy magical power, simply hadn’t responded quickly enough to the memory of *that day*—the day that had arrived without a word of warning just a few decades ago.

hunks.baseline: But two beings realized what was happening first—and more clearly than anyone else.
hunks.sol: But two beings recognized what was happening before anyone else, and more clearly.

hunks.baseline: The Lord of the Dead spoke to the Grand Mage, who was muttering as though possessed by something unseen, his voice vacant.
hunks.sol: The Lord of the Dead spoke to the Grand Mage, who was muttering in a daze as though possessed by something unseen.

hunks.baseline: But that wasn’t true.
hunks.sol: But he hadn’t.

hunks.baseline: With those quiet words, the Undead King held his unconscious friend in his arms and felt warmth pass into his fingertips.
hunks.sol: Holding his unconscious friend in his arms, the Undead King felt warmth against his fingertips.

hunks.baseline: Before something happened that couldn’t be undone.
hunks.sol: *Before something happens that can’t be undone.*

hunks.baseline: Unable to force out the words that had risen to the back of his throat, the Undead King and Magic Johnson turned away.
hunks.sol: Unable to force out the words that had risen to his throat, the Undead King turned away with Magic Johnson.

hunks.baseline: The three ominous syllables humanity had forgotten over the past few decades were branded into everyone’s minds once more.
hunks.sol: The ominous name humanity had forgotten over the past few decades was branded into everyone’s minds once more.

hunks.baseline: And even after the Grand Mage’s large-scale Warp Magic Formation appeared and vanished in a dazzling flash, a hard mechanical beep—one that hadn’t reached its owner—continued to ring out somewhere in the world.
hunks.sol: And even after the Grand Mage’s large-scale Warp Magic Formation appeared and vanished in a dazzling flash, a hard mechanical beep—one that had never reached its owner—continued to ring out somewhere in the world.

hunks.baseline: And even people who didn’t know it existed had no need for its warning messages. Every change came dramatically.
hunks.sol: And even people who didn’t know it existed had no need for its warning messages. The changes were dramatic enough on their own.

hunks.baseline: Or like a marauder who barged in without warning.
hunks.sol: They came like marauders, without warning.

hunks.baseline: The pit of this dreadful chaos wasn’t confined to any one place.
hunks.sol: This dreadful chaos wasn’t confined to any one place.

hunks.baseline: It was happening in underground bunkers around the world, where the people who ran entire nations had gathered; in cabinet meeting rooms; and, on a smaller scale, anywhere with an internet connection.
hunks.sol: It was unfolding in underground bunkers around the world, where the people who ran entire nations had gathered; in cabinet meeting rooms; and, on a smaller scale, anywhere with an internet connection.

hunks.baseline: A gigantic pillar, spewing darkness so vivid it looked unnatural—like a black hole sucking everything in.
hunks.sol: A gigantic pillar spewed darkness so vivid it looked unnatural, like a black hole sucking everything in.

hunks.baseline: Dazzling. That oppressive beam, so bright it seemed impossible to call it darkness, closed the sky. This time, it never opened again.
hunks.sol: A blinding, oppressive beam of light—though light seemed impossible to associate with that darkness—closed the sky. This time, it never opened again.

hunks.baseline: Like a horse galloping across the wilderness, the darkness raced silently through a world steeped in quiet.
hunks.sol: Like a horse galloping across the wilderness, the darkness raced silently through a world gone quiet.

hunks.baseline: By the time the Dragon Heart, having poured out all its strength, crumbled to dust, the catastrophe that had finally blossomed had already scattered its spores across the world.
hunks.sol: By the time the Dragon Heart had poured out all its strength and crumbled to dust, the catastrophe now in full bloom had already scattered its spores across the world.

hunks.baseline: “Mutation Gate? Shit, we’re calling that Code Red now? Report only Monster Waves!”
hunks.sol: “Mutation Gate? Shit, you’re calling that Code Red? Report only Monster Waves!”

hunks.baseline: A few years ago, the appearance of a Mutation Gate would have covered the front page of morning papers and dominated every breaking-news broadcast. Now the situation was so urgent that even that had become something to dismiss.
hunks.sol: A few years ago, a Mutation Gate would have covered the front page of morning papers and dominated every breaking-news broadcast. Now the situation was so urgent that even that had become something to dismiss.

hunks.baseline: “At least twenty percent of them have reached levels high enough to progress into Monster Waves…”
hunks.sol: “Roughly twenty percent or more have reached levels high enough to become Monster Waves…”

hunks.baseline: Seized by the sudden ringing in his ears, the superior fell silent. He squeezed out every last bit of strength and managed to say one thing.
hunks.sol: Seized by a sudden ringing in his ears, the superior fell silent. He squeezed out every last bit of strength and managed to say one thing.

hunks.baseline: A direct line that connected to only one place.
hunks.sol: A direct line to one place and one place only.

hunks.baseline: After a signal that seemed to ring on forever, someone answered. The tremor in the recipient’s voice was impossible to hide as they summed up the situation.
hunks.sol: After a signal that seemed to ring on forever, someone answered. A tremor crept into the recipient’s voice as they summed up the situation.

hunks.baseline: Or rather, anyone who understood what the words *Code Black* meant knew.
hunks.sol: As would anyone who understood what *Code Black* meant.

hunks.baseline: “It's begun.”
hunks.sol: “It’s begun.”

hunks.baseline: Though they differed in race and gender, these two hundred people shared one thing: they all led a nation. For a while, they looked at one another in silence.
hunks.sol: Though they differed in race and gender, these two hundred or so people shared one thing: they all led a nation. For a while, they looked at one another in silence.

hunks.baseline: He wasn’t a national leader, nor did he have the seasoned, battle-hardened political instincts they did. But he had every right to attend this gathering.
hunks.sol: He wasn’t a national leader, nor did he have the seasoned political instincts they did. But he had every right to attend this gathering.

hunks.baseline: His face was still healing, his hair matted with blood.
hunks.sol: His face was still wounded, his hair matted with blood.

hunks.baseline: Just as his grandfather, recorded in humanity’s history, had—and just as those who had fallen in Moscow today had.
hunks.sol: Just as his grandfather, whose name was recorded in humanity’s history, had—and just as those who had fallen in Moscow today had.

hunks.baseline: As if this place didn’t belong to him, Choi Minwoo stood alone and continued, his voice and eyes burning like torches.
hunks.sol: Standing alone, as if his place here belonged to someone else, Choi Minwoo continued, his eyes and voice burning like torches.
